user.title: Pair a Hue bridge
user.description: Search your network for Hue bridges, or enter the address of the bridge.

reconfigure.title: Pair again or pair another bridge
reconfigure.description: Search your network for Hue bridges, or enter the address of the bridge. Your switch mappings are kept.

pick.title: Choose a bridge
pick.description: Choose the Hue bridge to pair, or another address. Each bridge shows its address, its bridge id and how it was found.

no_bridges.title: No bridges found
no_bridges.description: Make sure the bridge is powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant. Search again, or enter its address.

data_description.address: IP address or host name, optionally with :port.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the Hue bridge again
reauth_confirm.description: The Hue bridge at {address} rejected the application key of sonoff2hue, which can't switch the lights until it is paired again. Select Submit, then press the round link button on top of the bridge within 60 seconds.

link_timeout.title: The link button was not pressed in time

import_yaml.title: Import sonoff2hue.yaml
import_yaml.description:
Paste the whole sonoff2hue.yaml: the Hue bridge under hue, and the MINIR4Ms under switches. If something else already toggles the lights for these switches, stop it first: with both running, every press would toggle the lights twice.

With the bridge's bridgeIp and appKey, sonoff2hue connects to the bridge with them; without them, you pair the bridge next. Each switch in the file becomes a switch of the integration.

data_description.config: Its application key and device keys are kept by Home Assistant and not shown again, so after an error, paste the file again.

import_pair.title: Pair the Hue bridge
import_pair.description: Pair the Hue bridge for the switches from the file: {switches}. Search your network for Hue bridges, or enter the address of the bridge.

import_failed.title: The bridge in the file can't be used

menu_options.import_pair: Pair the bridge again and keep the switches

create_entry.imported_unpinned:

user.title: Add switch
user.description: Find the MINIR4M that the wall switch is wired to: press the switch, pick the MINIR4M from the eWeLink devices seen on the LAN, or enter its device id.

menu_options.pick: Pick a device seen on the LAN

reconfigure.title: Edit {switch}
reconfigure.description: Keep the switch's MINIR4M, or find another one: press the wall switch, pick it from the eWeLink devices seen on the LAN, or enter its device id.

menu_options.pick: Pick a device seen on the LAN

identify_timeout.title: No press reported
identify_timeout.description: No eWeLink device reported a press within 60 seconds. The MINIR4M has to be on the same network as Home Assistant.

menu_options.pick: Pick a device seen on the LAN

pick.title: Pick a device
pick.description: The eWeLink devices seen on the LAN: those that no switch uses first, then by their last press.

no_devices.title: No devices seen
no_devices.description: No eWeLink devices seen on the LAN yet. Operate the wall switch, or enter the device id manually.

data_description.device_id: Letters and digits, 4 to 40 characters, e.g. 1000abcdef. The devices seen on the LAN show their ids.

settings.title: Switch settings
settings.description:
{device}

Choose what this switch toggles. If any of them is on, the switch turns them all off; otherwise it turns them all on.

data.name: Name
data.unresolved: Entries that don't match the bridge

data_description.name: Names the switch and its device, also in the log; without a name, the device id does. Up to 64 characters.
data_description.unresolved: These entries of the current mapping don't match the bridge. Remove them, or fix the names on the bridge.
data_description.light_names: Hue light names or ids, separated by commas, e.g. Ceiling, Floor lamp
data_description.group_names: room:Name or zone:Name (or ids), separated by commas, e.g. room:Hallway

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: The eWeLink device key lets sonoff2hue ignore relay and setting changes made in the eWeLink app. It also lets it check that the switch is in detached relay mode.

pair_first.title: Pair the Hue bridge first
pair_first.description: Then you can choose lights, rooms and zones from a list: reconfigure the sonoff2hue integration to pair the bridge. You can also enter them by hand, separated by commas.

lights_unavailable.title: Couldn't load the lights from the Hue bridge
lights_unavailable.description:
{error}

You can also enter them by hand, separated by commas.

invalid_config.title: The configuration has problems

not_detached.title: {name} is not in detached relay mode
not_detached.description: {name} is not in detached relay mode, so the wall switch cuts power to the lights. Enable 'Detach relay' in the eWeLink app.

decode_error.title: Can't decode the broadcasts of {name}
